categories_known_gap.overhead: CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_OVERHEAD is not among the activity kinds flagos enables (see cupti_device_tracer.cc: KERNEL/MEMCPY/MEMSET/RUNTIME/EXTERNAL_CORRELATION).
